program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((p1 (first (find-color g 1)))
         (p2 (first (find-color g 2)))
         (dr (- (fst p2) (fst p1)))
         (dc (- (snd p2) (snd p1))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (let* ((sr (- r dr))
               (sc (- c dc))
               (src-v (if (in-bounds? sr sc h w) (cell-at g sr sc) 0))
               (v (cell-at g r c)))
          (cond
            [(or (= v 1) (= v 2)) v]
            [(= src-v 3) 8]
            [(not (= v 0)) v]
            [else 0]))))))
